simple.meaning: שִׁיר (shîyr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to sing.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 88 times across Exodus, Numbers, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 13 more, beginning at Exodus 15:1. Its contexts include family line, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁיר (H7891).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שִׁיר (shîyr) / H7891 is traced through Exodus 15:1, Exodus 15:21, Numbers 21:17, Judges 5:1 as a generated source-based concept entry.
